alloy: Tap − and + to share the parts between the ores. Better ore is harder to work.
heat: Watch the colour, glow and sparks. Let go to ease off.
force: Hold longer to strike harder. Hot metal wants a light touch.
slag: Knock out the dark slag first. The spots beside it won't shape until it's gone.
hammer: Strike the marked spots. Your strike lands at the ring above your thumb when you lift it.
grind: Drag the stone along the edge, steady and even.
quench: Drag the piece to the tub and let go to quench.
